caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of woven fabric laid horizontally across a plain, light-colored background. The fabric is predominantly a pale beige or off-white, with vertical stripes in various colors: most notably several blue stripes of differing thicknesses, a thinner red stripe, and two thicker red bands near the center. On the far right, the fabric section transitions into a denser blue area made up of closely spaced blue lines. Three beige fabric ties extend upwards from the upper edge of the fabric at regular intervals. The texture and weave of the fabric are detailed, and the outer edges are slightly uneven. There are faint brownish stains and marks in the background, indicating aged or handled paper.
title: Handwoven Curtain
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
